notes: Their main damage was Shinbi (9k magical); 0/5 of us itemized magic resist — that hurt.

draftNote: 1 of five queued off a bottom-two lane: Mr_Meat31 (support→offlane).

coaching.headline: 14-1 in 11 minutes — three fights, all won, Mini Prime and Fangtooth banked off the last two.
coaching.team: Short and clean: 3-0 at 2.4 in their river, then 2-0s at 9.9 and 10.8 that cashed straight into Mini Prime and Fangtooth. Nobody on our side was caught out once. The only note for a longer game: the opening 3-0 converted nothing, and the comp carried no healer — against a team that doesn't fold by 11 minutes, those margins get tested.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The 9.9 and 10.8 picks — two kills each at our Mini Prime and our Fangtooth — turned a kill lead into the objective lead that ended it.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Phase went 0/0/5 — attached, alive, and on the assist for half the team's kills in 11 minutes. Nothing to fix at this length; the Crescelia opener was the only item the game allowed.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Sparrow went 6/0/1 into a lane that read Skylar's on paper — the scoreboard overruled it. Both game-ending picks (9.9, 10.8) had Sparrow at the center, and zero deaths is the line of the match.

synergy: Our engage/CC: Howitzer Land Mine (knockback). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Telekinetic Link an ally → Psychic Flare blind → Energy Lance → Hyperflux buff ult
ourKits.winCondition: buff a hyper-carry through the Link and Hyperflux for a teamfight
ourKits.passive: abilities heal her and her linked ally
ourKits.playWith: the strongest carry to Link and supercharge
ourKits.playAgainst: kill the linked carry, not Phase; break the link timing

ourKits.combo: Detection Protocol track → Chrono Swipe → Primeval Roar shield → Ursine Burst grab ult
ourKits.winCondition: grab a key target out of position and burst them down
ourKits.playWith: a team that collapses on his grabbed target
ourKits.playAgainst: his grab ult is the whole threat — bait it / stay spaced; CC during Primeval Roar

ourKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
ourKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
ourKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
ourKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

ourKits.combo: Slow Grenades / Land Mine zone → R2000 Missile → Make It Rain ult
ourKits.winCondition: wall off space with mines/grenades and rain artillery on a held enemy
ourKits.playWith: CC and chokes that force enemies into his zones
ourKits.playAgainst: immobile turret — flank his mine zones, dive when ult is down

ourKits.combo: Boreal Sweep slow → Hoarfrost root → Glacial Charge engage → Cryoseism stun ult
ourKits.winCondition: chain frost CC (slow→root→stun) to lock the fight down
ourKits.playWith: burst that converts her long CC chain into kills
ourKits.playAgainst: she's a CC battery — cleanse/QSS the Cryoseism stun; spread to avoid the chain

enemyKits.combo: Rushing Beat dashes → Line Tempo wolves → Circle Rhythm shield → All-Kill! wolfpack ult
enemyKits.winCondition: stack Track and unleash All-Kill! in a grouped fight
enemyKits.playAgainst: spread vs the wolfpack; she's squishy without her shield up

enemyKits.combo: Lash Kick gap-close+slow → Windburn %hp basics → Backlash push, Quelling Gale to disengage
enemyKits.passive: Rising Storm stacks grant attack speed
enemyKits.playWith: a team that lets her side-lane and pick
enemyKits.playAgainst: she wants 1v1s — group and burst her; Quelling Gale only stops projectiles

enemyKits.combo: Plasma Grenade → Hypercharge on-hit → Air Assault reposition → Atomiser ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Hypercharge and kite-shoot from Air Assault safety
enemyKits.passive: extra jump; kills cause corpse explosions
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline so she can free-fire airborne
enemyKits.playAgainst: CC her out of Air Assault; she's squishy on the ground

enemyKits.combo: Dread Nova stun → Ether Crystal push/lift → Particle Shredder channel → Synaptic Obliterator beams
enemyKits.winCondition: poke from max range and zone with the crystal
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline to protect his stationary channel
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Dread Nova; dive him during the immobile ult channel

loadout.name: Endless Hunt
loadout.text: Takedowns reset Sparrow's Basic Ability Cooldowns and permanently grant 1 Physical Penetration.
loadout.plain: Each takedown resets Piercing Shot, Hail of Arrows and Heightened Senses and adds permanent armor penetration. After the first kill she can stealth again and keep fighting.

loadout.name: Thraex
loadout.text: Mark the last Enemy Hero damaged by your Basic Attack for 3s, increasing your damage against them by 3% (+0.4% per level) and reducing the damage they deal to you by 1.5% (+0.35% per level).
loadout.plain: Basic attacks mark her target: she deals more damage to them and takes less from them. Fits her steady single-target attacking while Relentless stacks build.

loadout.name: Savage Strikes
loadout.text: Deal 1.5 (+0.4 per level) Physical Damage On-Hit. Attacking an Enemy Hero increases this by 100% for 3s, stacking up to 3 times. Heal for the damage dealt.
loadout.plain: Adds a bit of damage to each basic attack that grows while she keeps hitting a hero, and heals her. Strong with Heightened Senses' attack speed.

loadout.name: Ferocity
loadout.text: Gain 1% Total Attack Speed per 1s in Hero Combat, stacking infinitely.
loadout.plain: Attack speed keeps rising each second Sparrow stays in a hero fight, so long fights favor Sparrow more as they go. Weak in quick skirmishes.

loadout.name: Sharpshooter Crest
loadout.text: Legendary Marksman: On Successful Basic Attacks to Heroes or Monsters and Killing Units: Restore 1 Health (3 for Kills). After restoring 150 Health: Enter Base to Evolve into a Legendary Crest.
loadout.plain: Each Sparrow basic attack that lands on a hero or monster restores 1 health, and each unit kill restores 3. Heightened Senses' attack speed speeds up the count; after 150 health restored, a base trip upgrades the crest to Legendary.
